structure.refresh_draft: output: the shared revision result gains status capability_disabled with the closed missing_capabilities list and next_action enable_capability (only update_draft's style option answers it)
structure.update_draft: output: status gains capability_disabled with the closed missing_capabilities list (a disabled formatted_text_send or formatted_caption_send option is named, as prepare_text_send names its options) and next_action enable_capability
